1000008.name: Windbloom
1000008.title: Windbloom
1000008.desc: When Velina enters the battlefield, she gains 45 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>. Using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Purifying Rise</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Triple Deathblow</color> grants 45 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>, up to a maximum of 135 points. With enough <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Eye of the Storm</color>.

1000009.name: Top Hat Companion
1000009.title: Top Hat Companion
1000009.desc:
When using <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Hat Trick</color>, the thrown hat:
Is actually a Bangboo. While Top Hat Companion is on the field, it accumulates Preheated Chamber in Norma's place. When Norma retrieves the Top Hat Companion, all accumulated Preheated Chamber is transferred to her.
Top Hat Companion inherits all of Norma's stats.

1000010.name: En-Nah Turret
1000010.title: En-Nah Turret
1000010.desc:
The white turret summoned by <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: En-Nah Barrage</color>:
Automatically uses Special Attack: Target Practice at regular intervals. After deploying its missile bay, this skill is replaced with EX Special Attack: Explosive Experiment.
En-Nah Turrets inherit all of Norma's stats.

1000011.name: Preheated Chamber
1000011.title: Preheated Chamber
1000011.desc:
While Norma or her Top Hat Companion is on the field, gain 1.5% Preheated Chamber per second.
When Preheated Chamber reaches 80% or higher, the Quick Assist triggered by Basic Attack: Hat Trick is <color=#FFFFFF>replaced with a Chain Attack</color>.

1000012.name: En-Nah Barrage
1000012.title: En-Nah Barrage
1000012.desc:
The buff gained from <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: En-Nah Barrage</color>:
During its active duration, two En-Nah Turrets are summoned to fight alongside Norma.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability: Advantage in Numbers</color> is triggered, Norma's ATK is further increased, and all squad members deal increased DMG.

1000013.name: Tech Divide
1000013.title: Tech Divide
1000013.desc:
The debuff applied when Norma or her creations hit an enemy:
For the duration of the effect, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier is increased, and the duration of its Stunned state is extended.

1000014.name: Windbite
1000014.title: Windbite
1000014.desc: When Velina triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, she gains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>. When Velina has 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>, the next time she triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, she consumes 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color> to increase that instance's DMG Multiplier.

1000015.name: Condensed Cyclone
1000015.title: Condensed Cyclone
1000015.desc: When Velina triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, she summons a <color=#FFFFFF>Condensed Cyclone</color> that deals <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>. When the <color=#FFFFFF>Condensed Cyclone</color> dissipates, it triggers an explosion. If the explosion hits an enemy afflicted with a <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it deals one instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG.

1000016.name: Sweeping Cyclone
1000016.title: Sweeping Cyclone
1000016.desc: When Velina uses <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Eye of the Storm</color> or triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> while consuming 2 points of <Term:1000014>Windbite</Term>, she summons a <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> to continuously deal <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> that is capable of triggering the <Term:1000017>Chromatic Tint</Term> effect. When <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> attacks hit enemies, the enemy's <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly Buildup RES</color> and the corresponding <color=#FFFFFF>Attribute Anomaly Buildup RES</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Chromatic Tint</color> are reduced. When <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> dissipates, it triggers an explosion. If the explosion hits an enemy suffering a <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it deals one instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG.

1000017.name: Chromatic Tint
1000017.title: Chromatic Tint
1000017.desc: When <Term:1000016>Sweeping Cyclone</Term> hits an enemy afflicted with <color=#FFFFFF>Contamination</color> for the first time, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Chromatic Tint</color> effect, converting into a <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> of the corresponding attribute and dealing the corresponding attribute's DMG.

1000018.name: Solar Prominence
1000018.title: Solar Prominence
1000018.desc:
Upon entering the battlefield, Pyrois gains 30 <color=#FFFFFF>Solar Prominence</color>. Different attacks grant a certain amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Solar Prominence</color> when they hit enemies, and Pyrois also gains a certain amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Solar Prominence</color> every second.
With 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate Basic Attack: Celestial Light. Each hit from Basic Attack: Celestial Light consumes a certain amount of Solar Prominence.

1000019.name: Mirage
1000019.title: Mirage
1000019.desc: Pyrois enters the Mirage state when using Ultimate: Total Annihilation. While in the Mirage state, Pyrois' Ultimate deals increased CRIT DMG against Stunned enemies.

1000020.name: Sunflare
1000020.title: Sunflare
1000020.desc: Pyrois enters the Sunflare state when using Ultimate: Triumphant Return. While Sunflare is active, Energy Generation Rate and DMG dealt increase, and triggering a Perfect Block with an EX Special Attack restores additional <Term:1000018><color=#FFFFFF>Solar Prominence</color></Term>.

1000021.name: Totalize
1000021.title: Totalize
1000021.desc:
Grants a special effect against Stunned enemies.
When Pyrois triggers Totalize, additional DMG is dealt, and the target's Stunned state ends.

1000022.name: Cinderfire
1000022.title: Cinderfire
1000022.desc: Gain Cinderfire when using a Chain Attack. All Cinderfire stacks are consumed upon using an Ultimate, granting a certain amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Decibels</color> for each stack consumed.

1000023.name: Anomaly Effect Strength
1000023.title: Anomaly Effect Strength
1000023.desc:
When applying Attribute Anomaly Buildup to an enemy, each attack's ATK, PEN, Anomaly Proficiency, DMG Bonus, and other effects proportionally increase the resulting <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly Effect Strength</color> based on that attack's contribution to the total Attribute Anomaly Buildup.
PEN effects: Includes PEN and PEN Ratio
DMG Bonus: Includes both non-Attribute DMG Bonus and Attribute DMG Bonus

1000024.name: Purr Energy
1000024.title: Purr Energy
1000024.desc:
Nekomata gains 40 Purr Energy upon entering the battlefield. She recovers 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Purr Energy</color> every second, and different skills restore different amounts of Purr Energy on hit.
When Purr Energy is at least 40, press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> after triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to consume 30 Purr Energy and activate Dodge: Disappearing Tail.
When Purr Energy is at least 40, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 40 Purr Energy and directly activate Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw.

1000025.name: Pawpad Ambush
1000025.title: Pawpad Ambush
1000025.desc:
Nekomata enters Pawpad Ambush state for 40s after using Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While Pawpad Ambush is active, all of Nekomata's attacks count as hitting from behind and trigger Super Mean Pawprint, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> equal to 30% of Nekomata's ATK. This effect can trigger once every 1s.

1000026.name: Fright
1000026.title: Fright
1000026.desc: While <Term:1000027><color=#FFFFFF>Spotless</color></Term> is active, each activation of Drusilla or Anastella's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Morning Cleanup</color> grants 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Fright</color>. Upon reaching 6 stacks, the next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Morning Cleanup</color> consumes all <color=#FFFFFF>Fright</color> stacks and is replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Midnight Cleanup</color>.

1000027.name: Spotless
1000027.title: Spotless
1000027.desc: While this is active, Drusilla or Anastella automatically uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Morning Cleanup</color> to attack enemies and gain <Term:1000026><color=#FFFFFF>Fright</color></Term>. After using the skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit timer resets.

1000028.name: Formation Breaker
1000028.title: Formation Breaker
1000028.desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice</color> hits a Stunned elite or boss enemy for the first time, Sigrid enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Formation Breaker</color> state.
While in <color=#FFFFFF>Formation Breaker</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to continuously use the 1st through 3rd stages of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>.

1000029.name: Unbridled Spear
1000029.title: Unbridled Spear
1000029.desc:
The 4th hit of the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> are considered <color=#FFFFFF>Unbridled Spear</color> skills.
When Sigrid hits an enemy with any <color=#FFFFFF>Unbridled Spear</color>, if she is not currently in the <Term:1000030><color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color></Term> state, she enters the <Term:1000030><color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color></Term> state and gains 1 activation of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>, up to 1 activation can be stored.

1000030.name: Aerial Patrol Spear
1000030.title: Aerial Patrol Spear
1000030.desc: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to use <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>. When Sigrid uses any <Term:1000029><color=#FFFFFF>Unbridled Spear</color></Term>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color> state is refreshed, and she gains 1 activation of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>. Up to 1 activation can be stored.

1000031.name: Refringe
1000031.title: Refringe
1000031.desc: If an enemy has <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color>, when they're about to be inflicted with an Anomaly, that Anomaly is <color=#FFA9DD>Refringed</color>. After being <color=#FFA9DD>Refringed</color>, the Anomaly's <Term:1000023><color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly Effect Strength</color></Term> is enhanced based on the provider's <color=#FFA9DD>Refringe Coefficient</color>, increasing the total DMG that Anomaly can deal.

1000032.name: Floating Radiance
1000032.title: Floating Radiance
1000032.desc:
Remielle can gain <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> through <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> reaches its maximum of 120, Remielle can enter the <Term:1000035><color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color></Term> state.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> is consumed over time. When <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> is fully consumed, Remielle exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state.
1000032.skill: Special Attack: Ode to Dawn - Radiant Turn

1000033.name: Voidflare
1000033.title: Voidflare
1000033.desc: When a squad member triggers Remielle's <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux</color> <Term:1000031><color=#FFFFFF>Refringe</color></Term> reaction, Remielle generates <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflare</color> based on the enhanced <Term:1000023><color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly Effect Strength</color></Term> of that Attribute Anomaly after it has been <color=#FFA9DD>Refringed</color>. Up to the 3 most recently generated <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflares</color> can be stored.
1000033.skill: Core Passive: Temporal Patterns = Stilled Colors

1000034.name: Luminize
1000034.title: Luminize
1000034.desc: Deals Attribute Anomaly DMG to enemies using the skill's DMG Multiplier, based on the <Term:1000023><color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly Effect Strength</color></Term> of all stored <Term:1000033><color=#FFFFFF>Voidflare</color></Term>.
1000034.skill: Core Passive: Temporal Patterns = Stilled Colors

1000035.name: Phase Flow
1000035.title: Phase Flow
1000035.desc: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, Remielle acts autonomously to assist in combat. During this, some attacks can also apply <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> to the target. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, <Term:1000032><color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color></Term> is consumed over time. When <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> is fully depleted, she exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state. Before exiting the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, she cannot be actively switched in except through <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color>.
1000035.skill: Special Attack: Ode to Dawn - Radiant Turn

1000036.name: Crimson Inscription
1000036.title: Crimson Inscription
1000036.desc: Transforms her weapon into a Blood Axe, replacing Claret's attacks with Bloodbloom Oath skills and increasing her CRIT Rate and Gash Buildup Rate.
1000036.skill: EX Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Secret Forging Techniques

1000037.name: Remnant Edge
1000037.desc: When any squad member triggers Maim, Armorer Agents enter Remnant Edge, during which Laceration DMG increases.

1000038.name: Cleanse
1000038.title: Cleanse
1000038.desc: Reverts the enemy's <color=#FFFFFF>Windswept</color> state to an uncontaminated <color=#FFFFFF>Windswept</color> state.

1000039.name: Wind Energy
1000039.title: Wind Energy
1000039.desc: For every set amount of Energy consumed, gain 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Wind Energy</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace</color> consumes all <color=#FFFFFF>Wind Energy</color> to generate the corresponding number of <Term:1000040>Eyes of the Storm</Term>.

1000040.name: Eye of the Storm
1000040.title: Eye of the Storm
1000040.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace</color> consumes all <Term:1000039><color=#FFFFFF>Wind Energy</color></Term>, leaving the corresponding number of <color=#FFFFFF>Eyes of the Storm</color> on the field. When hit by <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off</color>, they detonate to generate Miniature Windstorms or Giant Windstorms.

1000041.name: Flow
1000041.title: Flow
1000041.desc:
When Severian hits enemies with specific skills or triggers a Perfect Dodge, he gains <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> is capped at 150.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> reaches 100, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> and use <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt</color>.

1000042.name: Shadowflash
1000042.title: Shadowflash
1000042.desc:
When Severian enters the battlefield, he gains 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color>. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
When Severian has <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color> and is not Invulnerable, if he is hit by a non-Control Skill attack from an enemy and fails to actively dodge or parry the attack, Severian consumes 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color> to automatically dodge the attack and use <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color> can stack up to 2 times. If Severian gains <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color> while possessing max stacks, he gains 1 stack of <Term:1000043><color=#FFFFFF>Windborne</color></Term> instead, and his next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Swift Edge</color> is upgraded to <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind</color>.

1000043.name: Windborne
1000043.title: Windborne
1000043.desc: Each time Severian triggers a Perfect Dodge, he gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Windborne</color>. When Severian has <color=#FFFFFF>Windborne</color>, switching to Severian or having Severian enter via a Quick Assist consumes this effect and automatically uses his <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill</color>.

1000046.name: Combustion Attack
1000046.title: Combustion Attack
1000046.desc:
Some of Phoenix's skills count as Combustion Attacks. While performing a Combustion Attack, her Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and dealing DMG restores <Term:1000047><color=#FFFFFF>Pyre</color></Term>. Phoenix can have up to 120 points of Pyre.
After performing a Combustion Attack, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to skip the retreat portion of Special Attack: Fire Sweep and EX Special Attack: Blazing Slash, and immediately follow up with an upward slash.

1000047.name: Pyre
1000047.title: Pyre
1000047.desc: When a <Term:1000046><color=#FFFFFF>Combustion Attack</color></Term> deals DMG, it generates Pyre. Phoenix can have up to 120 Pyre. With enough Pyre, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Purifying Flame</color>.

1000048.name: Sear
1000048.title: Sear
1000048.desc: When any squad member deals Anomaly DMG to an enemy, the enemy enters the Sear state. While in the Sear state, Anomaly DMG taken by the enemy has a chance to CRIT.

1000049.name: Ascension
1000049.title: Ascension
1000049.desc: Using EX Special Attack: Falling Sun grants 1 point of Ascension. Phoenix can have up to 1 point of Ascension. While Phoenix has Ascension, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to use <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Blazing Slash</color>.

2000001.name: Corruptive Barrier
2000001.title: Corruptive Barrier
2000001.desc:
· <color=#FFAF2C>CRIT DMG RES, ATK, and Anti-Interrupt</color> are increased while all Agents in the squad lose HP over time.
· When the Corruptive Barrier is broken, a portion of HP is converted into HP for all Agents in the squad, and Energy is restored.

2000002.name: Miasmic Shield
2000002.title: Miasmic Shield
2000002.desc:
· <color=#FFAF2C>DEF, DMG reduction</color>, and <color=#FFAF2C>Anti-Interrupt</color> are significantly enhanced, and the enemy will not be Stunned. Agents can deplete the Miasmic Shield through attacks.
· When the Miasmic Shield is broken, enemies take <color=#FFAF2C>Purify</color> DMG, and Agents <color=#FFAF2C>recover Energy or Adrenaline</color>.

2000003.name: Control Skill
2000003.title: Control Skills
2000003.desc:
· Skills <color=#FFAF2C>ignore the Invulnerable effect</color> and have no flash prompts. Agents cannot activate their Ultimates during this time. Only one Agent switch is allowed per enemy attack, and each Agent can only perform one dodge.
· <color=#FFAF2C>Defensive Assist</color> or <color=#FFAF2C>Evasive Assist</color> can be used to counter this skill. Successfully countering all skills inflicts the <color=#FFAF2C>Shutdown</color> effect on the enemy, dealing massive DMG and accumulating a large amount of Daze.

2000004.name: Chain Parry
2000004.title: Chain Parry
2000004.desc:
· When an <color=#FFAF2C>×-shape golden light</color> prompt appears on an enemy attack, <color=#FFAF2C>tap twice</color> in quick succession on <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to trigger a Chain Parry. Both Agents will parry the attack together and <color=#FFAF2C>accumulate a large amount of Daze</color>;
· After successfully triggering a Chain Parry, tap <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch a Chain Assault.

2000005.name: Rift Assault
2000005.title: Rift Assault
2000005.desc: After Kusarikku slips into a spatial fissure, it unleashes a series of powerful attacks. Use <color=#FFAF2C>Defensive Assists</color> to counter them and rapidly reduce its <Term:2000001><color=#FFFFFF>Corruptive Barrier</color></Term>. Repeatedly countering them successfully can allow you to seize the initiative in battle.

2000006.name: Counter Assist
2000006.title: Counter Assist
2000006.desc: When an enemy uses a <color=#FFAF2C>Control Skill</color> to attack, if a specific Agent is in your squad, a <color=#FFAF2C>golden flash</color> prompt will appear. Press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> within a short window to switch to that specific Agent and trigger <color=#FFAF2C>Counter Assist</color>. Then press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to engage in a tug-of-war with the enemy. Succeed, and you'll break free from the enemy's <color=#FFAF2C>Control Skill</color>.

3000001.name: Ether Veil
3000001.title: Ether Veil
3000001.desc:
A special domain created by certain skills.
While active, characters or enemies on the field gain its corresponding effects, such as enhancing characters, weakening enemies, or triggering Special Attacks.

3000002.name: Abloom
3000002.title: Abloom
3000002.desc:
An additional damage effect triggered when certain skills hit enemies affected by an Attribute Anomaly.
When triggered, it deals an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG. The exact DMG multiplier varies based on character stats and skill mechanics.

3000003.name: Disorder
3000003.title: Disorder
3000003.desc: Applying another type of Attribute Anomaly to an enemy that has already been afflicted with one overrides the original, and causes the <color=#FFAF2C>Disorder</color> effect. The <color=#FFAF2C>Disorder</color> effect is calculated based on the original Anomaly, <color=#FFAF2C>dealing additional DMG and accumulating Daze</color>.

3000004.name: Vortex
3000004.title: Vortex
3000004.desc:
When applying a different type of Attribute Anomaly effect to an enemy already afflicted with an Attribute Anomaly, if one of the Anomaly effects is <Term:3000011><color=#FFFFFF>Windswept</color></Term>, <Term:3000003><color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color></Term> will not be triggered. Instead, the <color=#A6C5FD>Vortex</color> effect will be triggered: Upon triggering, the Attribute Anomaly other than <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color> will be settled, dealing <color=#FFAF2C>AoE Anomaly DMG</color> of the corresponding attribute.
For a period of time after triggering <color=#A6C5FD>Vortex</color>, it cannot be triggered again. Additionally, triggering <color=#A6C5FD>Vortex</color> <color=#FFAF2C>forces</color> the enemy into the <Term:3000010><color=#FFFFFF>Contamination</color></Term> state corresponding to <color=#A6C5FD>Vortex</color>'s attribute.

3000005.name: Anomaly Buildup
3000005.title: Anomaly Buildup
3000005.desc: When characters deal Attribute damage, <color=#FFAF2C>Anomaly Buildup</color> is accumulated. The enemy's current <color=#FFAF2C>Anomaly Buildup</color> is displayed to the right of its HP. When the <color=#FFAF2C>Anomaly Buildup</color> reaches its limit, the enemy will be afflicted with the corresponding <color=#FFAF2C>Attribute Anomaly</color>. The effect of an <color=#FFAF2C>Attribute Anomaly</color> is related to the characters who inflicted <color=#FFAF2C>Anomaly Buildup</color> and their contributions.

3000006.name: Assault
3000006.title: Assault
3000006.desc:
The <IconMap:Icon_GeneralBuff_PhysDmg> <color=#F0D12B>Physical Attribute Anomaly</color> is <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color>.
The <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> effect can interrupt enemy actions and deal massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

3000007.name: Shock
3000007.title: Shock
3000007.desc:
The <IconMap:Icon_GeneralBuff_Thunder> <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Attribute Anomaly</color> is <color=#2EB6FF>Shock</color>.
The <color=#2EB6FF>Shock</color> effect causes the target to intermittently take additional <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> when attacked for a period of time.
Inflicting <color=#2EB6FF>Shock</color> on enemies weak to <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color> can interrupt their actions.

3000008.name: Polarity Disorder
3000008.title: Polarity Disorder
3000008.desc:
A special <Term:3000003><color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color></Term> effect.
Triggered when certain skills hit enemies affected by an Attribute Anomaly, dealing Disorder DMG without removing the target's current Attribute Anomaly.

3000009.name: Gather Enemies
3000009.title: Gather Enemies
3000009.desc: An effect that attracts or pulls nearby enemies together, making it easier for characters to hit multiple enemies at once and improving AoE DMG and combat efficiency.

3000010.name: Contamination
3000010.title: Contamination
3000010.desc:
An additional Attribute effect triggered during the <Term:3000011><color=#FFFFFF>Windswept</color></Term> state.
When an enemy is in the Windswept state, the first instance of <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>, or <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> they receive triggers the corresponding Attribute's Contamination effect. While Contamination is active, the <color=#A6C5FD>direct Wind DMG</color> and direct DMG of the Attribute that triggered Contamination received by the enemy are both increased based on the Tempest Coefficient of the character who triggered the Wind Anomaly.
Contamination can only be triggered once this way during the same <Term:3000011><color=#FFFFFF>Windswept</color></Term> state.

3000011.name: Windswept
3000011.title: Windswept
3000011.desc:
<IconMap:Icon_GeneralBuff_Wind> <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color> is the <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color> state.
When an enemy enters the <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color> state, their actions are interrupted, and they take massive <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
While in the <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color> state, the <color=#A6C5FD>direct Wind DMG</color> they receive is increased based on the Tempest Coefficient of the character who triggered the Wind Anomaly.

3000012.name: Quick Swap
3000012.title: Quick Swap
3000012.desc: An action where a character briefly takes the field to use a key skill or trigger an effect, then quickly switches back to another character to continue fighting.

3000013.name: Versatile
3000013.title: Versatile
3000013.desc: A versatile type with broad applications, typically not tied to any single character, team, or combat scenario, and useful across a variety of setups.

3000014.name: Cycle
3000014.title: Cycle
3000014.desc: A sequence of actions that a character or team repeatedly performs in combat, typically involving building up resources, using key skills, triggering effects, and then preparing for the next round of damage.

3000015.name: Laceration DMG
3000015.title: Laceration DMG
3000015.desc:
A CRIT DMG bonus exclusive to <Term:3000016><color=#FFFFFF>Sharp DMG</color></Term>.
When Sharp DMG triggers a critical hit, the CRIT DMG Bonus does not apply. Instead, a Laceration DMG Bonus is calculated. If CRIT Rate exceeds 100% and a critical hit has already been triggered, the excess CRIT Rate is used for an additional Laceration check. If Laceration is triggered, a Laceration DMG Bonus is calculated an additional time.

3000016.name: Sharp DMG
3000016.title: Sharp DMG
3000016.desc: <IconMap:Icon_AvatarClass_Armorer> All DMG dealt by Armorer characters is <color=#FFAF2C>Sharp DMG</color>, with <color=#FFAF2C>DEF</color> used as the skill DMG Multiplier. When a critical hit is triggered, Sharp DMG does not benefit from the CRIT DMG Bonus and instead calculates a <Term:3000015><color=#FFFFFF>Laceration DMG</color></Term> bonus.

3000017.name: Converging Spear
3000017.title: Converging Spear
3000017.desc: A special Basic Attack Sigrid can launch while in the <Term:1000030><color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color></Term> state. When used, she unleashes the stage of this attack based on the number accumulated, up to 3 stages. Stages can be accumulated or retained through blocking, chaining skills, and other methods.

3000018.name: Qingming Sword Force
3000018.title: Qingming Sword Force
3000018.desc:
An exclusive resource Ye Shunguang builds up in combat and gains through certain skills.
When 6 points of Qingming Sword Force are accumulated, Ye Shunguang can enter the <Term:3000019><color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color></Term> state and gain access to more powerful skills. While in the Enlightened Mind state, Qingming Sword Force is consumed as skills are used or as time passes. When Qingming Sword Force is insufficient or depleted, Ye Shunguang exits the <Term:3000019><color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color></Term> state.

3000019.name: Enlightened Mind
3000019.title: Enlightened Mind
3000019.desc:
Ye Shunguang's enhanced combat state.
After entering the Enlightened Mind state, some of Ye Shunguang's skills, including her Basic Attack and EX Special Attack, become enhanced Enlightened Mind skills. When <Term:3000018><color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color></Term> is insufficient or depleted, Ye Shunguang exits the Enlightened Mind state.

3000020.name: Airborne Hover
3000020.title: Airborne Hover
3000020.desc: A combat state in which Ye Shunguang rises into the air and briefly hovers, allowing her to chain into certain aerial combos. While in the <Term:3000019><color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color></Term> state, some combos can only be performed after entering the Airborne Hover state.

3000021.name: Dual Form
3000021.title: Dual Form
3000021.desc:
Ye Shunguang has two combat states.
<Term:3000019><color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color></Term> is her enhanced combat state. While in this state, some of Ye Shunguang's skills, including her Basic Attack and EX Special Attack, are enhanced.

3000022.name: Fallen Frost
3000022.title: Fallen Frost
3000022.desc:
Hoshimi Miyabi's exclusive combat resource, obtained through certain attacks, her Ultimate, or when any squad member triggers <Term:3000003><color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color></Term>.
When 6 points of Fallen Frost are accumulated, Hoshimi Miyabi can <color=#FFAF2C>hold</color> <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to enter <Term:3000033><color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color></Term> and begin charging. Releasing the button or depleting Fallen Frost unleashes the powerful Basic Attack: Shimotsuki, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.

3000023.name: Charged Slash
3000023.title: Charged Slash
3000023.desc:
Hoshimi Miyabi's powerful skill Basic Attack: Shimotsuki.
When she has 2 or more points of <Term:3000022><color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color></Term>, <color=#FFAF2C>hold</color> <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Hoshimi Miyabi sheathes her blade, enters <Term:3000033><color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color></Term>, and begins charging. Each charge stage consumes 2 points of Fallen Frost, up to a maximum of 3 stages. When the button is released, or Fallen Frost is depleted, Hoshimi Miyabi draws her blade and unleashes a powerful forward slash based on the current number of charge stages, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>, then exits Shimotsuki Stance.

3000024.name: Totalize
3000024.title: Totalize
3000024.desc: When an EX Special Attack or Ultimate hits a Stunned enemy, Totalize is triggered, increasing the skill's DMG Multiplier based on the enemy's remaining Stun duration when Totalize is triggered. After Totalize is triggered, the enemy's Stunned state immediately ends, and a certain amount of Daze is reapplied based on the enemy's remaining Daze when Totalize was triggered.

3000025.name: Flash Freeze Charge
3000025.title: Flash Freeze Charge
3000025.desc:
Ellen's exclusive combat resource.
While Ellen is in the <Term:3000034><color=#FFFFFF>Roaming</color></Term> state, hitting enemies with Swift Scissors or Charged Scissor Strike grants Flash Freeze Charges. When Ellen has Flash Freeze Charges, she can consume a certain amount after specific skills to use Basic Attack: Glacial Blade Wave, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.

3000026.name: Dual Ultimate Mechanic
3000026.title: Dual Ultimate Mechanic
3000026.desc:
Yixuan has two Ultimates triggered under different conditions, switching between them based on her current resources.
When Decibel Rating reaches <color=#FFAF2C>Maximum</color>, she can use Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade. When <Term:3000035><color=#FFFFFF>Technique Point</color></Term> is sufficient, she can use Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression. If both Technique Point and Decibel Rating meet their respective requirements, Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression takes priority. Both Ultimates deal massive <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.

3000027.name: Hunter's Gait
3000027.title: Hunter's Gait
3000027.desc: An enhanced state Pulchra enters after using an EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, or Ultimate. While in Hunter's Gait, Pulchra deals increased Daze. Additionally, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with a Special Attack or EX Special Attack, Pulchra's Aftershock is triggered.

3000028.name: Stance
3000028.title: Stance
3000028.desc:
Tsukishiro Yanagi has two Stances: Jougen and Kagen.
In combat, Tsukishiro Yanagi gains corresponding buffs based on her current Stance:
Jougen Buff: Increases her Electric DMG and Anti-Interrupt Level during Basic Attacks.
Kagen Buff: Increases her PEN Ratio and Interrupt Level of Basic Attacks.

3000029.name: Suppressive Mode
3000029.title: Suppressive Mode
3000029.desc:
A special attack mode Zhu Yuan enters by <color=#FFAF2C>holding</color><IconMap:Icon_Normal>.
In Suppressive Mode, Zhu Yuan uses her shotgun to perform up to 3 stages of piercing shots forward. If she has Enhanced Shotshells when firing, she consumes 1 <Term:3000037><color=#FFFFFF>Enhanced Shotshells</color></Term> to deal massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>. Releasing Basic Attack exits this mode.

3000030.name: Summon Motorcycle
3000030.title: Summon Motorcycle
3000030.desc: Starlight - Billy's mechanic for summoning his motorcycle to attack using certain skills. After summoning it, he can use motorcycle-based skills, including drifting, ramming, spinning, launching enemies, and ground slams to deal <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. Certain motorcycle skills make him invulnerable while in use and can be chained into other EX Special Attacks.

3000031.name: Dual Ranged/Melee Forms
3000031.title: Dual Ranged/Melee Forms
3000031.desc:
Asaba Harumasa can fight using both ranged shots and close-range attacks.
In combat, ranged shots can apply Electro Prison to enemies. When Electro Prison reaches 2 or more stacks, the target becomes X-Marked. At this point, Asaba Harumasa can move in at close range and deal damage with slashing skills such as Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.

3000032.name: Dashing Slash
3000032.title: Dashing Slash
3000032.desc: When an X-Marked enemy is present on the field, Harumasa enters the Awakened state. While Awakened, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> while dodging to trigger Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash, quickly dashing toward an X-Marked enemy and unleashing a powerful slash. When the slash hits, it consumes Electro Prison and X-Marked. Before X-Marked is depleted, repeatedly press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to continuously trigger Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.

3000033.name: Shimotsuki Stance
3000033.title: Shimotsuki Stance
3000033.desc:
A special charging stance Hoshimi Miyabi enters when consuming <Term:3000022><color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color></Term> to use Basic Attack: Shimotsuki.
When Hoshimi Miyabi has 2 or more points of Fallen Frost, she can <color=#FFAF2C>hold</color> <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to enter Shimotsuki Stance. She is invulnerable while in Shimotsuki Stance.

3000034.name: Roaming
3000034.title: Roaming
3000034.desc:
Ellen's high-speed movement state.
<color=#FFAF2C>Hold</color> or <color=#FFAF2C>double-press</color><IconMap:Icon_Evade> to enter Roaming, gaining brief invulnerability upon entering. While Roaming, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to use Swift Scissors, or <color=#FFAF2C>hold</color><IconMap:Icon_Normal> to use Charged Scissor Strike. Hitting an enemy with Swift Scissors or Charged Scissor Strike grants <Term:3000025><color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color></Term>.

3000035.name: Technique Point
3000035.title: Technique Point
3000035.desc:
Yixuan's exclusive combat resource.
Upon entering combat, Yixuan gains <color=#FFAF2C>120</color> points of <Term:3000036><color=#FFFFFF>Adrenaline</color></Term>. Consuming Adrenaline restores Technique Points. When Technique Points reach <color=#FFAF2C>120</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to use Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression.

3000036.name: Adrenaline
3000036.title: Adrenaline
3000036.desc:
<IconMap:Icon_AvatarClass_Rupture> Energy exclusive to the Rupture Specialty.
Rupture Agents must consume Adrenaline to use an EX Special Attack. Hitting enemies with skills such as Basic Attacks and Dodge Counters grants Adrenaline.
The Adrenaline gauge is displayed below HP, and the amount required for an EX Special Attack is shown on the gauge as a red marker.

3000037.name: Enhanced Shotshells
3000037.title: Enhanced Shotshells
3000037.desc:
Zhu Yuan's exclusive combat resource.
By accumulating Enhanced Shotshells, Zhu Yuan can increase the power of certain skills. Using skills such as her EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, Ultimate, or Assist Follow-Up allows her to quickly gain Enhanced Shotshells.

3000038.name: Gash
3000038.title: Gash
3000038.desc: <Term:3000016><color=#FFFFFF>Sharp DMG</color></Term> causes Gash buildup. When Gash buildup is full, the enemy is inflicted with Gash. Gash can be used to trigger <Term:3000039><color=#FFFFFF>Maim</color></Term>, dealing additional DMG. Gash can stack up to 3 times.

3000039.name: Maim
3000039.title: Maim
3000039.desc: When an enemy has at least 1 stack of <Term:3000038><color=#FFFFFF>Gash</color></Term>, certain skills can consume Gash on hit to trigger Maim and deal additional DMG.

3000040.name: Sharpness
3000040.title: Sharpness
3000040.desc:
<IconMap:Icon_AvatarClass_Armorer> Energy exclusive to the Armorer Specialty.
Armorer Agents must consume Sharpness to use an EX Special Attack. Hitting enemies with skills such as Basic Attacks and Dodge Counters grants Sharpness.
The Sharpness gauge is displayed below HP, and the amount required for an EX Special Attack is shown on the gauge as a red marker.

4000001.name: Basic Technique
4000001.title: Basic Technique
4000001.desc: There are 3 buffs that can reduce the required score of an order, making the order <IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon01> -1, <IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon02> -1, and <IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon03> -1

4000002.name: Starfish
4000002.title: Starfish
4000002.desc: A type of Sea Materials used to make souvenirs, providing the scores needed to fulfill orders

4000003.name: Bottle Cap
4000003.title: Bottle Cap
4000003.desc: A type of Sea Materials used to make souvenirs, providing the scores needed to fulfill orders

4000004.name: Giant Crab Claw
4000004.title: Giant Crab Claw
4000004.desc: A type of Sea Materials used to make souvenirs, providing the scores needed to fulfill orders

4000005.name: Conch
4000005.title: Conch
4000005.desc: A type of Sea Materials used to make souvenirs, providing the scores needed to fulfill orders

4000006.name: Pebble
4000006.title: Pebble
4000006.desc: A type of Sea Materials used to make souvenirs, providing the scores needed to fulfill orders

4000007.name: Overflow Score
4000007.title: Overflow Score
4000007.desc: The portion of the Sea Materials score that exceeds the order score requirement when an order is completed

4000008.name: Single-Color Order
4000008.title: Single-Color Order
4000008.desc: Orders with only one score requirement, using the order's original required score as the benchmark

4000009.name: Three-Color Order
4000009.title: Three-Color Order
4000009.desc: Orders with three types of score requirements, judged by the order's original required score

4000010.name: White Feather
4000010.title: White Feather
4000010.desc: When a skill is released, current order <IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon01><IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon02><IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon03> randomly -1

4000011.name: Black Feather
4000011.title: Black Feather
4000011.desc: When a skill is released, a random Sea Materials <IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon01><IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon02><IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon03> randomly +1

4000012.name: Durability
4000012.title: Durability
4000012.desc: Reduces the Durability consumed by this Gear by 1, to a minimum of 1.

4000013.name: Core
4000013.title: Core
4000013.desc: Increases the Agent's Core Skill level by <color=#2BAD00>1</color>.

4000014.name: Skill
4000014.title: Skill
4000014.desc: Increases the level of all the Agent's skills except Core Skill by <color=#2BAD00>1</color>.

4000015.name: Shield
4000015.title: Shield
4000015.desc: After this Agent remains out of combat for <color=#2BAD00>10</color>s, they gain a shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>3%</color> of their Max HP. This effect can be triggered once every <color=#2BAD00>30</color>s.

4000016.name: Corruption Resistance
4000016.title: Corruption Resistance
4000016.desc: Each time when receiving Corruption, this Agent takes <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> less DMG for <color=#2BAD00>15</color>s.

4000017.name: Dodge
4000017.title: Dodge
4000017.desc: Gain 1 additional Dodge use. <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color> is more likely to trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>.

4000018.name: Charge Up
4000018.title: Charge Up
4000018.desc: While this Agent's HP is above <color=#2BAD00>80%</color>, they deal <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> more DMG and inflict <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more Anomaly Buildup.

4000019.name: Curtain
4000019.title: Curtain
4000019.desc: While Ether Veil is active, hitting an enemy increases their Stun DMG Multiplier by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>15</color>s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

4000020.name: Skill
4000020.title: Skill
4000020.desc: Increases the level of all the Agent's skills except Core Skill by <color=#2BAD00>2</color>.

4000021.name: Shield
4000021.title: Shield
4000021.desc: After this Agent remains out of combat for <color=#2BAD00>10</color>s, they gain a shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>6%</color> of their Max HP. This effect can be triggered once every <color=#2BAD00>30</color>s.

4000022.name: Corruption Resistance
4000022.title: Corruption Resistance
4000022.desc: Each time when receiving Corruption, this Agent takes <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> less DMG for <color=#2BAD00>30</color>s.

4000023.name: Charge Up
4000023.title: Charge Up
4000023.desc: While this Agent's HP is above <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>, they deal <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> more DMG and inflict <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more Anomaly Buildup.

4000024.name: Swift
4000024.title: Swift
4000024.desc: After triggering a Perfect Dodge, this Agent's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>10</color>s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

4000025.name: Basic Attack
4000025.title: Basic Attack
4000025.desc: When a Basic Attack hits an enemy, this Agent's ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>4%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>10</color>s. This effect can stack up to <color=#2BAD00>3</color> times.

4000026.name: Abloom
4000026.title: Abloom
4000026.desc: After triggering Abloom, this Agent's Anomaly DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>6%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>12</color>s. This effect can stack up to <color=#2BAD00>2</color> times.

4000027.name: Disorder
4000027.title: Disorder
4000027.desc: After triggering Disorder, this Agent's DMG ignores <color=#2BAD00>6%</color> of the target's All-Attribute RES for <color=#2BAD00>12</color>s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

4000028.name: Follow-up Attack
4000028.title: Follow-up Attack
4000028.desc: When Aftershock hits an enemy, this Agent's DMG ignores <color=#2BAD00>8%</color> of the target's DEF for <color=#2BAD00>10</color>s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

4000029.name: Pierce
4000029.title: Pierce
4000029.desc: After performing an EX Special Attack, this Agent's Sheer DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>3%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>15</color>s. This effect can stack up to <color=#2BAD00>2</color> times.

4000030.name: Chain Attack
4000030.title: Chain Attack
4000030.desc: When an Agent performs a Chain Attack, their CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>16%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>12</color>s. Gaining this effect again resets its duration.

4000031.name: Blood Rage
4000031.title: Blood Rage
4000031.desc: When this Agent loses HP, their CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>16%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>8</color>s. Gaining this effect again resets its duration.

4000032.name: Vortex
4000032.title: Vortex
4000032.desc: When triggering a Vortex, this Agent's Anomaly DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>15</color>s. Gaining this effect again resets its duration.

4000033.name: Energy Generation
4000033.title: Energy Generation
4000033.desc: Performing an Ultimate restores <color=#2BAD00>20</color> Energy for this Agent.

4000034.name: Stun
4000034.title: Stun
4000034.desc: Stunning an enemy restores <color=#2BAD00>300</color> Decibels. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>30</color>s.

4000035.name: Strong Shield
4000035.title: Strong Shield
4000035.desc: While an Agent has a shield, their CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.

4000036.name: Strength
4000036.title: Strength
4000036.desc: Increases the DMG of each hit dealt by all attack Cards. Each stack of <Term:4000036><color=#FFFFFF>Strength</color></Term> adds 1 to final DMG. All stacks are cleared at the end of the turn.

4000037.name: Cheer
4000037.title: Cheer
4000037.desc: Increases the total DMG dealt by the next attack Card. Each stack of <Term:4000037><color=#FFFFFF>Cheer</color></Term> increases total DMG by 10%. All stacks are consumed after attacking and cleared at the end of the turn.

4000038.name: Energize
4000038.title: Energize
4000038.desc: Increases the combo count of all attack Cards by 1 for every 10 stacks of <Term:4000038><color=#FFFFFF>Energize</color></Term>. Persists permanently and is not cleared between turns.

4000039.name: Opening
4000039.title: Opening
4000039.desc: Triggers an additional effect when this Card is placed at the far left of your hand

4000040.name: Curtain Call
4000040.title: Curtain Call
4000040.desc: Triggers an additional effect when this Card is placed at the far right of your hand

4000041.name: Chain Attack
4000041.title: Chain Attack
4000041.desc: Triggers an additional effect when the previous Card is a Chain Attack Card

4000042.name: Buildup
4000042.title: Buildup
4000042.desc: Includes the <Term:4000050><color=#FFFFFF>Kinetic Buildup</color></Term> and <Term:4000051><color=#FFFFFF>Precise Buildup</color></Term> Cards. Sell these Cards to gain stacks of <Term:4000038><color=#FFFFFF>Energize</color></Term>.

4000043.title: Strength
4000043.desc: Increases the DMG of each hit dealt by all attack Cards. Each stack of <Term:4000036><color=#FFFFFF>Strength</color></Term> adds 1 to final DMG. All stacks are cleared at the end of the turn.

4000044.name: Cheer
4000044.title: Cheer
4000044.desc: Increases the total DMG dealt by the next attack Card. Each stack of <Term:4000037><color=#FFFFFF>Cheer</color></Term> increases total DMG by 10%. All stacks are consumed after attacking and cleared at the end of the turn.

4000045.name: Energize
4000045.title: Energize
4000045.desc: Increases the combo count of all attack Cards by 1 for every 10 stacks of <Term:4000038><color=#FFFFFF>Energize</color></Term>. Persists permanently and is not cleared between turns.

4000049.name: Buildup
4000049.title: Buildup
4000049.desc: Includes the <Term:4000050><color=#FFFFFF>Kinetic Buildup</color></Term> and <Term:4000051><color=#FFFFFF>Precise Buildup</color></Term> Cards. Sell these Cards to gain stacks of <Term:4000038><color=#FFFFFF>Energize</color></Term>.

4000050.name: Kinetic Buildup
4000050.title: Kinetic Buildup
4000050.desc:
Sell this Card to gain stacks of <Term:4000038><color=#FFFFFF>Energize</color></Term>.
Effect of the 1-star version: When sold, this Card grants 3 <Term:4000038><color=#FFFFFF>Energize</color></Term> instead of Coin

4000051.name: Precise Buildup
4000051.title: Precise Buildup
4000051.desc:
Sell this Card to gain stacks of <Term:4000038><color=#FFFFFF>Energize</color></Term>.
Effect of the 1-star version: When sold, this Card grants 16% <Term:4000038><color=#FFFFFF>Energize</color></Term> instead of Coin

4000052.name: Little Flame
4000052.title: Little Flame
4000052.desc: This Card transforms into <Term:4000053><color=#FFFFFF>Flame of Rebirth</color></Term> when its star level increases

4000053.name: Flame of Rebirth
4000053.title: Flame of Rebirth
4000053.desc: This Card transforms into <Term:4000054><color=#FFFFFF>Fields of Fire</color></Term> when its star level increases

4000054.name: Fields of Fire
4000054.title: Fields of Fire
4000054.desc:
The Fireball Build relies on frequently crafting other Cards to obtain <Term:4000054><color=#FFFFFF>Fields of Fire</color></Term>.
Effect of the 1-star version: Increases this Card's DMG by 100% for each <Term:4000054><color=#FFFFFF>Fields of Fire</color></Term> Card played

10000081.name: Windbloom
10000081.title: Windbloom
10000081.desc: When Velina enters the battlefield, she gains 45 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>. Using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Purifying Rise</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Triple Deathblow</color> grants 45 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>, up to a maximum of 135 points. With enough <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Eye of the Storm</color>.
